#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
diagnostics.py -- LAN / host health & connectivity diagnostics.

Runs a battery of live checks and records measurable results:
  D1  Gateway ICMP reachability + latency (loss%, min/avg/max)
  D2  Gateway TCP/443 service probe (is the router's admin/HTTPS up?)
  D3  DNS resolution test (resolve + measure, show resolver)
  D4  Public connectivity + latency (HTTP GET to 2 endpoints, w/ timings)
  D5  Per-neighbor latency (ping each ARP host: reachable + avg ms)
  D6  Interface error/discard counters (netstat -e)
  D7  DHCP lease details (ipconfig /all)
  D8  Wi-Fi link quality        [ADMIN + Location, else noted]

Outputs diagnostics_<ts>.txt (human) + diagnostics_<ts>.json (machine,
for attestation chaining). No fabrication: every number is measured.

Usage:
  python diagnostics.py
  python diagnostics.py --quiet     # print only, no files
"""
import subprocess, re, os, sys, json, datetime, time, socket, statistics, glob

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

def run(cmd, timeout=30):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                             timeout=timeout, shell=True).stdout
    except Exception as e:
        return f"__ERR__{e}"

def banner(t):
    return "\n" + "=" * 70 + "\n" + t + "\n" + "=" * 70

def parse_ping(out):
    res = {"sent": 0, "recv": 0, "lost": 0, "loss_pct": None,
           "min": None, "avg": None, "max": None}
    m = re.search(r"Sent = (\d+), Received = (\d+), Lost = (\d+) \((\d+)% loss\)", out)
    if m:
        res.update(sent=int(m.group(1)), recv=int(m.group(2)),
                   lost=int(m.group(3)), loss_pct=int(m.group(4)))
    m2 = re.search(r"Minimum = (\d+)ms, Maximum = (\d+)ms, Average = (\d+)ms", out)
    if m2:
        res.update(min=int(m2.group(1)), avg=int(m2.group(2)), max=int(m2.group(3)))
    return res

def latency_to(ip, count=4, timeout_ms=1000):
    return parse_ping(run(f"ping -n {count} -w {timeout_ms} {ip}"))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def d1_gateway():
    out = banner("[D1] Gateway ICMP reachability + latency")
    gw = "192.168.1.1"
    r = latency_to(gw, 4, 1000)
    out += (f"\n  target {gw}: sent={r['sent']} recv={r['recv']} "
             f"lost={r['lost']} ({r['loss_pct']}% loss)  "
             f"min={r['min']} avg={r['avg']} max={r['max']} ms")
    out += "\n  => healthy if 0% loss and avg < ~5ms on Wi-Fi / <1ms wired."
    return out, {"gw_icmp": r}

def d2_gw_tcp():
    out = banner("[D2] Gateway TCP/443 service probe")
    gw = "192.168.1.1"
    t0 = time.time()
    ok = False
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection((gw, 443), timeout=3)
        s.close(); ok = True
    except Exception as e:
        msg = str(e)
    dt = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000, 1)
    out += f"\n  connect {gw}:443 -> {'OPEN' if ok else 'CLOSED/timeout'} ({dt} ms)"
    out += "\n  => confirms the router's HTTPS admin plane is reachable on L2+L4."
    return out, {"gw_tcp443": {"open": ok, "ms": dt}}

def d3_dns():
    out = banner("[D3] DNS resolution test")
    name = "cloudflare-dns.com"
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        ips = socket.gethostbyname_ex(name)[2]
        dt = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000, 1)
        out += f"\n  resolve {name} -> {ips}  ({dt} ms)"
        ok = True
    except Exception as e:
        out += f"\n  resolve {name} -> FAILED: {e}"
        ok, ips, dt = False, [], None
    dnscfg = run("ipconfig /all")
    srv = re.findall(r"DNS Servers[ .:]+([\d.]+)", dnscfg)
    srv = [s for s in srv if re.match(r"^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}$", s)]
    out += f"\n  configured DNS servers: {sorted(set(srv))}"
    out += "\n  => resolver responsive if an IP returns and latency is low."
    return out, {"dns": {"name": name, "ok": ok, "ips": ips, "ms": dt,
                          "servers": sorted(set(srv))}}

def d4_public():
    out = banner("[D4] Public connectivity + latency")
    tests = [("https://1.1.1.1", "Cloudflare"), ("https://www.google.com", "Google")]
    res = {}
    for url, label in tests:
        t0 = time.time()
        body = run(f'curl -s -o nul -w "%{{http_code}} %{{time_total}}" {url}')
        dt = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000, 1)
        code = body.split()[0] if body.split() else "?"
        tt = body.split()[1] if len(body.split()) > 1 else "?"
        out += f"\n  {label:12} {url:28} HTTP {code}  total={tt}s  wall={dt}ms"
        res[label] = {"http": code, "ttfb_s": tt, "wall_ms": dt}
    out += "\n  => egress works if HTTP 2xx/3xx and total time is sane (<2s)."
    return out, {"public": res}

def d5_neighbors():
    out = banner("[D5] Per-neighbor latency (each ARP host)")
    raw = run("arp -a")
    ips = [m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(
        r"^\s*(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s+[0-9a-fA-F-]{17}\s+dynamic", raw, re.M)]
    res = {}
    out += f"\n  scanning {len(ips)} neighbors:"
    for ip in sorted(ips, key=lambda s: [int(x) for x in s.split(".")]):
        r = latency_to(ip, 2, 800)
        tag = f"loss={r['loss_pct']}% avg={r['avg']}ms" if r['avg'] is not None else "no reply"
        out += f"\n    {ip:16} {tag}"
        res[ip] = r
    out += ("\n  => hosts that answer = live & on-segment. Consistent with ARP table;\n"
            "     a host in ARP but 100% loss repeatedly can mean ARP cache stale or host filtered.")
    return out, {"neighbors": res}

def d6_iface_errors():
    out = banner("[D6] Interface error / discard counters (netstat -e)")
    raw = run("netstat -e")
    out += "\n" + raw.strip()
    err = re.search(r"Errors\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", raw)
    disc = re.search(r"Discards\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", raw)
    res = {}
    if err:
        res["errors"] = {"recv": int(err.group(1)), "send": int(err.group(2))}
    if disc:
        res["discards"] = {"recv": int(disc.group(1)), "send": int(disc.group(2))}
    out += ("\n  => non-zero recv-errors/discards can indicate duplex mismatch, "
            "cable/firmware issues, or ongoing L2 disruption. 0 = clean.")
    return out, {"iface_counters": res}

def d7_dhcp():
    out = banner("[D7] DHCP lease details (ipconfig /all)")
    raw = run("ipconfig /all")
    myip = re.search(r"IPv4 Address[ .:]+([\d.]+)", raw)
    dhcp = re.search(r"DHCP Enabled[ .:]+(Yes|No)", raw)
    srv = re.search(r"DHCP Server[ .:]+([\d.]+)", raw)
    lease = re.search(r"Lease Obtained[ .:]+([^\r\n]+)", raw)
    exp = re.search(r"Lease Expires[ .:]+([^\r\n]+)", raw)
    out += (f"\n  IPv4            : {myip.group(1) if myip else '?'}\n"
             f"  DHCP Enabled    : {dhcp.group(1) if dhcp else '?'}\n"
             f"  DHCP Server     : {srv.group(1) if srv else '?'}\n"
             f"  Lease Obtained : {lease.group(1).strip() if lease else '?'}\n"
             f"  Lease Expires  : {exp.group(1).strip() if exp else '?'}")
    out += "\n  => a lease expiring soon or a DHCP server that isn't your gateway merits a look."
    res = {"ipv4": myip.group(1) if myip else None,
           "dhcp_enabled": dhcp.group(1) if dhcp else None,
           "dhcp_server": srv.group(1) if srv else None}
    return out, {"dhcp": res}

def d8_wifi():
    out = banner("[D8] Wi-Fi link quality   [ADMIN + Location required]")
    raw = run("netsh wlan show interfaces")
    if "requires elevation" in raw or "Location" in raw or "error 5" in raw:
        out += ("\n  BLOCKED: needs admin shell + Location ON. Manual:\n"
                "    netsh wlan show interfaces\n"
                "  Look for: Signal (%), Transmit/Receive rate, Channel, PHY type.\n"
                "  Weak signal (<50%) or high channel congestion = retry/latency source.")
    else:
        sig = re.search(r"Signal\s*:\s*(\d+%)", raw)
        ch = re.search(r"Channel\s*:\s*(\d+)", raw)
        rate = re.search(r"Transmit rate\s*:\s*([^\r\n]+)", raw)
        out += (f"\n  Signal={sig.group(1) if sig else '?'}  "
                 f"Channel={ch.group(1) if ch else '?'}  "
                 f"TxRate={rate.group(1).strip() if rate else '?'}")
    return out, {}

def collect():
    """Run all D-modules, return (human_report, metrics_dict)."""
    rep, metrics = [], {}
    rep.append(banner(f"DIAGNOSTICS  @ {datetime.datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}"))
    rep.append(f"Host: {socket.gethostname()}  (192.168.1.21)  Subnet: 192.168.1.0/24")
    for fn in (d1_gateway, d2_gw_tcp, d3_dns, d4_public, d5_neighbors,
               d6_iface_errors, d7_dhcp, d8_wifi):
        s, m = fn()
        rep.append(s); metrics.update(m)
    return "\n".join(rep), metrics

def watcher():
    """Diff a fresh run against the most-recent sealed diagnostics JSON.
    Flags regressions: new/disappeared neighbor, gateway latency spike,
    interface errors/discards > 0, DNS-server change, DHCP-server change,
    public-egress failure."""
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(HERE, "diagnostics_*.json")))
    # exclude any we just wrote this second via collect(); pick the prior latest
    base = files[-1] if files else None
    report, metrics = collect()
    ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    txt = os.path.join(HERE, f"diagnostics_{ts}.txt")
    js = os.path.join(HERE, f"diagnostics_{ts}.json")
    with open(txt, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(report)
    with open(js, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"generated": ts, "host": socket.gethostname(),
                   "metrics": metrics}, f, indent=2)

    print(report)
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("[WATCHER] regression diff vs last baseline")
    print("=" * 70)
    if not base:
        print("  No prior diagnostics_*.json found -> this run is the new baseline.")
        print(f"  [saved] {txt}\n  [saved] {js}")
        return

    prev = json.load(open(base, encoding="utf-8"))["metrics"]
    cur = metrics
    alerts = []

    # 1) neighbor set changes
    pset = set(prev.get("neighbors", {}))
    cset = set(cur.get("neighbors", {}))
    for ip in sorted(cset - pset):
        alerts.append(f"NEW neighbor appeared: {ip}")
    for ip in sorted(pset - cset):
        alerts.append(f"neighbor disappeared: {ip}")

    # 2) gateway latency spike (avg ms)
    pgw = prev.get("gw_icmp", {}).get("avg")
    cgw = cur.get("gw_icmp", {}).get("avg")
    if pgw is not None and cgw is not None and cgw > pgw * 2 and cgw >= 10:
        alerts.append(f"gateway latency spike: {pgw}ms -> {cgw}ms")

    # 3) interface errors / discards > 0
    ec = cur.get("iface_counters", {})
    for k in ("errors", "discards"):
        d = ec.get(k, {})
        tot = (int(d.get("recv", 0) or 0) + int(d.get("send", 0) or 0))
        if tot > 0:
            alerts.append(f"interface {k} > 0: recv={d.get('recv')} send={d.get('send')}")

    # 4) DNS server change
    pdns = set(prev.get("dns", {}).get("servers", []))
    cdns = set(cur.get("dns", {}).get("servers", []))
    if pdns != cdns:
        alerts.append(f"DNS servers changed: {sorted(pdns)} -> {sorted(cdns)}")

    # 5) DHCP server change
    pdh = prev.get("dhcp", {}).get("dhcp_server")
    cdh = cur.get("dhcp", {}).get("dhcp_server")
    if pdh != cdh:
        alerts.append(f"DHCP server changed: {pdh} -> {cdh}")

    # 6) public egress failure
    for label, r in cur.get("public", {}).items():
        if str(r.get("http", "")) not in ("200", "301", "302", "304"):
            alerts.append(f"public egress {label} degraded: HTTP {r.get('http')}")

    if alerts:
        print(f"\n  ALERTS ({len(alerts)}):")
        for a in alerts:
            print(f"    ! {a}")
        print("\n  OVERALL: REGRESSION DETECTED")
    else:
        print("\n  No regressions vs baseline. OVERALL: STABLE")
    print(f"\n  baseline: {os.path.basename(base)}\n  current : {os.path.basename(js)}")
    print(f"  [saved] {txt}\n  [saved] {js}")

def main():
    if "--watcher" in sys.argv:
        watcher()
        return
    quiet = "--quiet" in sys.argv
    report, metrics = collect()
    print(report)
    ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    if not quiet:
        txt = os.path.join(HERE, f"diagnostics_{ts}.txt")
        js = os.path.join(HERE, f"diagnostics_{ts}.json")
        with open(txt, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(report)
        with open(js, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"generated": ts, "host": socket.gethostname(),
                       "metrics": metrics}, f, indent=2)
        print(f"\n[saved] {txt}\n[saved] {js}")
    else:
        print("\n__JSON__" + json.dumps(metrics))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Live ARP gateway spoofing monitor.

Resolves the current default gateway IP, reads its MAC from `arp -a`, and
re-checks it every INTERVAL seconds. If the gateway's MAC ever changes (the
classic ARP-spoofing / MITM signal), it prints an ALERT and (optionally)
can run a custom command.

Stays within L2: it never trusts a single reading — it samples twice with a
short gap and only flags when BOTH agree on a changed MAC, to avoid
false positives from transient cache flushes.

Usage:
  python gateway_monitor.py [interval_seconds] [duration_seconds]
  duration 0 or omitted = run forever (Ctrl-C to stop)

Example:
  python gateway_monitor.py 10 0
"""
import subprocess, re, sys, time, datetime

def run(cmd):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, shell=True).stdout
    except Exception:
        return ""

def gateway_ip():
    out = run("ipconfig")
    lines = out.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if "Default Gateway" in line:
            # IPv4 gateway is usually on the next 1-2 indented lines
            for nxt in lines[i:i+3]:
                m = re.search(r"(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})", nxt)
                if m and m.group(1) != "0.0.0.0":
                    return m.group(1)
    return None

def arp_mac(ip):
    out = run(f"arp -a {ip}")
    m = re.search(rf"{re.escape(ip)}\s+([0-9a-fA-F-]{{17}})", out)
    return m.group(1).upper() if m else None

def main():
    interval = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 10
    duration = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0
    gw = gateway_ip()
    if not gw:
        print("ERROR: could not determine default gateway")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"[monitor] gateway IP = {gw}  interval = {interval}s  "
          f"{'forever' if duration == 0 else str(duration)+'s'}")
    baseline = arp_mac(gw)
    print(f"[monitor] baseline gateway MAC = {baseline}")
    if not baseline:
        print("[monitor] WARNING: gateway MAC not in ARP cache yet; will learn on first sample")
    start = time.time()
    seen = baseline
    while True:
        time.sleep(interval)
        m1 = arp_mac(gw)
        time.sleep(1.5)
        m2 = arp_mac(gw)
        # require two agreeing samples to flag (avoid cache-flush false positives)
        if m1 and m2 and m1 == m2 and m1 != seen:
            ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
            print(f"\n!!! ARP SPOOF ALERT @ {ts} !!!")
            print(f"    Gateway {gw} MAC CHANGED:")
            print(f"    previous = {seen}")
            print(f"    current  = {m1}")
            print(f"    This is the signature of an ARP man-in-the-middle attack.\n")
            seen = m1
        elif m1 == seen and m1 is not None:
            ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
            print(f"[{ts}] OK  gateway {gw} = {m1}")
        else:
            print(f"[{datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] WARN gateway MAC not readable right now ({m1}/{m2})")
        if duration and (time.time() - start) >= duration:
            print("[monitor] duration reached, exiting")
            break

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
rag.py — local RAG engine (zero API key, all on your hardware).

Backend: Chroma (PersistentClient — local dir, no server) by default;
         falls back to sqlite if --store sqlite or chroma unavailable.

Pipeline:
  ingest  URL/file  -> markdown (Crawl4AI / markitdown / docling)
                     -> chunk -> embed (nomic-embed-text | bge-m3)
                     -> store (chroma collection per --collection)
  query  question   -> embed -> top-k (chroma ANN + cosine)
                     -> optional rerank with bge-m3 (stage 2)
                     -> Ollama synthesis -> answer

Usage:
  python rag.py ingest --url https://... [--collection web] [--embed-model bge-m3] [--store chroma]
  python rag.py query  "question?" [--collection web] [--model qwen2.5:7b] [--rerank]
  python rag.py list
"""
import argparse, asyncio, json, sqlite3, sys, os
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434"
DEFAULT_EMBED = "nomic-embed-text"
RERANK_EMBED = "bge-m3"
CHROMA_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "chroma_store"
SQLITE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "rag_store.db"
CHUNK_CHARS = 1200
CHUNK_OVERLAP = 150


# ---------- embedding ----------
def embed(texts, model=DEFAULT_EMBED):
    if isinstance(texts, str):
        texts = [texts]
    payload = {"model": model, "input": texts}
    import urllib.request
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/embed", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())["embeddings"]


# ---------- crawl / convert ----------
async def url_to_md(url):
    from crawl4ai import AsyncWebCrawler, BrowserConfig, CrawlerRunConfig
    async with AsyncWebCrawler(config=BrowserConfig(headless=True, browser_type="chromium")) as c:
        res = await c.arun(url=url, config=CrawlerRunConfig(cache_mode="BYPASS"))
    return res.markdown if res.success else ""


def file_to_md(path):
    try:
        from docling.document_converter import DocumentConverter
        return DocumentConverter().convert(str(path)).document.export_to_markdown()
    except Exception:
        try:
            from markitdown import MarkItDown
            return MarkItDown().convert(str(path)).text_content
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"no doc converter available: {e}")


def chunk_text(text, size=CHUNK_CHARS, overlap=CHUNK_OVERLAP):
    text = text or ""
    if len(text) <= size:
        return [text] if text.strip() else []
    out, start = [], 0
    while start < len(text):
        out.append(text[start:start + size])
        start += size - overlap
    return [c for c in out if c.strip()]


# ---------- stores ----------
class ChromaStore:
    def __init__(self, collection):
        import chromadb
        self._client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(CHROMA_DIR))
        self._col = self._client.get_or_create_collection(
            collection, metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"})
        self.name = collection

    def clear(self, source):
        try:
            ids = self._col.get(where={"source": source}, include=[])["ids"]
            if ids:
                self._col.delete(ids=ids)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def add(self, source, chunks, vecs):
        ids = [f"{source}#{i}" for i in range(len(chunks))]
        self._col.add(ids=ids, documents=chunks, embeddings=vecs,
                      metadatas=[{"source": source, "idx": i} for i in range(len(chunks))])

    def query(self, qvec, k=8):
        r = self._col.query(query_embeddings=[qvec], n_results=k,
                            include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"])
        out = []
        for doc, meta, dist in zip(r["documents"][0], r["metadatas"][0], r["distances"][0]):
            # chroma returns distance (cosine=1-sim); convert to similarity
            out.append((1.0 - dist, meta["source"], meta["idx"], doc))
        return out


class SqliteStore:
    def __init__(self, collection):
        self.name = collection
        self._con = sqlite3.connect(SQLITE_PATH)
        self._con.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, collection TEXT, source TEXT,
            chunk_index INTEGER, text TEXT, vec TEXT)""")

    def clear(self, source):
        self._con.execute("DELETE FROM chunks WHERE collection=? AND source=?",
                          (self.name, source))
        self._con.commit()

    def add(self, source, chunks, vecs):
        for i, (ch, vec) in enumerate(zip(chunks, vecs)):
            self._con.execute(
                "INSERT INTO chunks (collection, source, chunk_index, text, vec) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (self.name, source, i, ch, json.dumps(vec)))
        self._con.commit()

    def query(self, qvec, k=8):
        rows = self._con.execute(
            "SELECT source, chunk_index, text, vec FROM chunks WHERE collection=?",
            (self.name,)).fetchall()
        out = []
        qv = np.array(qvec, dtype=np.float32)
        for src, idx, text, vec in rows:
            v = np.array(json.loads(vec), dtype=np.float32)
            sim = float(np.dot(qv, v) / (np.linalg.norm(qv) * np.linalg.norm(v) + 1e-9))
            out.append((sim, src, idx, text))
        out.sort(reverse=True)
        return out[:k]


def get_store(collection, backend):
    if backend == "chroma":
        try:
            return ChromaStore(collection)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [warn] chroma unavailable ({e}); falling back to sqlite", file=sys.stderr)
            return SqliteStore(collection)
    return SqliteStore(collection)


# ---------- ingest / retrieve / answer ----------
def ingest(collection, source_label, md, embed_model=DEFAULT_EMBED, backend="chroma"):
    chunks = chunk_text(md)
    if not chunks:
        print("  no text extracted", file=sys.stderr)
        return 0
    vecs = embed(chunks, embed_model)
    store = get_store(collection, backend)
    store.clear(source_label)
    store.add(source_label, chunks, vecs)
    return len(chunks)


def _cos(a, b):
    return float(np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b) + 1e-9))


def rerank(question, candidates, top_n=4):
    qvec = np.array(embed(question, RERANK_EMBED)[0], dtype=np.float32)
    re = []
    for sim, src, idx, text in candidates:
        try:
            v = np.array(embed(text, RERANK_EMBED)[0], dtype=np.float32)
            rsim = _cos(qvec, v)
        except Exception:
            rsim = sim
        re.append((rsim, src, idx, text))
    re.sort(reverse=True)
    return re[:top_n]


def answer(question, collection, model, k=4, do_rerank=False, backend="chroma", embed_model=DEFAULT_EMBED):
    store = get_store(collection, backend)
    stage1 = store.query(embed(question, embed_model)[0], k=8)
    if not stage1:
        return "(no documents ingested in this collection)", []
    final = rerank(question, stage1, top_n=k) if do_rerank else stage1[:k]
    context = "\n\n".join(f"[src={s}#{i}]\n{t}" for _, s, i, t in final)
    prompt = ("Answer the question using ONLY the context. If the context does not "
              "contain the answer, say so. Cite source ids.\n\n"
              f"CONTEXT:\n{context}\n\nQUESTION: {question}")
    import urllib.request
    payload = {"model": model, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False, "options": {"temperature": 0.1}}
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/generate", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        resp = json.loads(r.read())
    return resp.get("response", ""), final


def list_collections(backend="chroma"):
    if backend == "chroma":
        import chromadb
        client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(CHROMA_DIR))
        for name in client.list_collections():
            col = client.get_collection(name.name)
            print(f"  {name.name}: {col.count()} chunks")
    else:
        con = sqlite3.connect(SQLITE_PATH)
        for c, s, n in con.execute(
                "SELECT collection, source, COUNT(*) FROM chunks GROUP BY collection, source").fetchall():
            print(f"  {c}: {s} ({n} chunks)")


# ---------- CLI ----------
def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    ing = sub.add_parser("ingest")
    g = ing.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    g.add_argument("--url"); g.add_argument("--file")
    ing.add_argument("--collection", default="default")
    ing.add_argument("--embed-model", default=DEFAULT_EMBED)
    ing.add_argument("--store", default="chroma", choices=["chroma", "sqlite"])

    q = sub.add_parser("query")
    q.add_argument("question")
    q.add_argument("--collection", default="default")
    q.add_argument("--model", default="qwen2.5:7b")
    q.add_argument("--embed-model", default="bge-m3", help="must match the model used at ingest")
    q.add_argument("--k", type=int, default=4)
    q.add_argument("--rerank", action="store_true")
    q.add_argument("--store", default="chroma", choices=["chroma", "sqlite"])

    ls = sub.add_parser("list")
    ls.add_argument("--store", default="chroma", choices=["chroma", "sqlite"])

    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.cmd == "ingest":
        label = args.url or args.file
        print(f"[ingest] {'crawling' if args.url else 'converting'} {label} ...", file=sys.stderr)
        md = asyncio.run(url_to_md(args.url)) if args.url else file_to_md(args.file)
        n = ingest(args.collection, label, md, args.embed_model, args.store)
        print(f"[ok] ingested {n} chunks into '{args.collection}' (embed={args.embed_model}, store={args.store})")

    elif args.cmd == "query":
        ans, hits = answer(args.question, args.collection, args.model, args.k,
                           args.rerank, args.store, args.embed_model)
        print(ans)
        if os.environ.get("RAG_DEBUG"):
            print("\n--- sources ---", file=sys.stderr)
            for s, i, t in [(h[1], h[2], h[3]) for h in hits]:
                print(f"  {s}#{i}: {t[:80]}...", file=sys.stderr)

    elif args.cmd == "list":
        list_collections(args.store)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
mcp_server.py — MCP server exposing the ZQM local toolkit to agents (Cline / Claude / Cursor).
Zero API key. Talks to local Ollama + (optional) local SearXNG.

Tools:
  ingest_url(url, collection)   -> crawl + embed into RAG store
  ingest_file(path, collection)-> convert doc + embed
  rag_query(question, collection, model) -> retrieved-answer from local store
  crawl_extract(url, model)    -> crawl URL -> markdown + Ollama extraction
  web_search(query, n)         -> SearXNG (if running at SEARXNG_URL, else error)

Run (stdio, for MCP client):
  python mcp_server.py
Wire into Cline (cline_mcp_settings.json):
  { "mcpServers": { "zqm-local": { "command": "<venv>/Scripts/python",
      "args": ["<repo>/mcp_server.py"] } } }
"""
import asyncio, os, sys, json, base64, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server import Server
from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server
from mcp.types import TextContent, Tool

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import rag  # our RAG engine

SEARXNG_URL = os.environ.get("SEARXNG_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434"
ANYTHINGLLM_URL = os.environ.get("ANYTHINGLLM_URL", "http://localhost:3001")
ANYTHINGLLM_KEY = os.environ.get("ANYTHINGLLM_KEY", "")


def _allm_request(method, path, body=None):
    """Call the AnythingLLM API with the bearer key from env."""
    url = f"{ANYTHINGLLM_URL}/api/v1{path}"
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method,
                                 headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {ANYTHINGLLM_KEY}",
                                          "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())


def _ollama_generate(model, prompt, images=None):
    payload = {"model": model, "prompt": prompt, "stream": False}
    if images:
        payload["images"] = images
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/generate",
                                 data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read()).get("response", "")


def _moondream(image_b64, prompt):
    """Local vision QA via moondream. Handles NDJSON streaming."""
    payload = {"model": "moondream", "prompt": prompt, "images": [image_b64]}
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/generate",
                                 data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    parts = []
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        for line in r:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                o = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                continue
            parts.append(o.get("response", ""))
            if o.get("done"):
                break
    return "".join(parts)

app = Server("zqm-local-tools")


def _run(coro):
    return asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(coro)


@app.list_tools()
async def list_tools():
    return [
        Tool(name="ingest_url", description="Crawl a URL and embed it into the local RAG store.",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "url": {"type": "string"}, "collection": {"type": "string", "default": "default"}},
                 "required": ["url"]}),
        Tool(name="ingest_file", description="Convert a local doc (pdf/docx/...) and embed into RAG store.",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "path": {"type": "string"}, "collection": {"type": "string", "default": "default"}},
                 "required": ["path"]}),
        Tool(name="rag_query", description="Answer a question from the local RAG store using local Ollama.",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "question": {"type": "string"}, "collection": {"type": "string", "default": "default"},
                 "model": {"type": "string", "default": "qwen3:8b"}},
                 "required": ["question"]}),
        Tool(name="crawl_extract", description="Crawl a URL -> markdown + structured extraction via local Ollama.",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "url": {"type": "string"}, "model": {"type": "string", "default": "qwen3:8b"}},
                 "required": ["url"]}),
        Tool(name="image_query", description="Ask the local vision model (moondream) about an image (base64 or file path).",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "prompt": {"type": "string"}, "image_path": {"type": "string"},
                 "image_b64": {"type": "string"}},
                 "required": ["prompt"]}),
        Tool(name="web_search", description="Search the web via local SearXNG (requires running instance).",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "query": {"type": "string"}, "n": {"type": "integer", "default": 5}},
                 "required": ["query"]}),
        Tool(name="allm_ingest", description="Upload+embed a local doc into an AnythingLLM workspace (persistent RAG).",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "path": {"type": "string"}, "workspace": {"type": "string", "default": "zqm-mesh"}},
                 "required": ["path"]}),
        Tool(name="allm_query", description="Chat/RAG-query an AnythingLLM workspace (uses its Ollama LLM + embeddings).",
             inputSchema={"type": "object", "properties": {
                 "question": {"type": "string"}, "workspace": {"type": "string", "default": "zqm-mesh"},
                 "mode": {"type": "string", "default": "query"}},
                 "required": ["question"]}),
    ]


@app.call_tool()
async def call_tool(name, arguments):
    try:
        if name == "ingest_url":
            md = await rag.url_to_md(arguments["url"])
            n = rag.ingest(arguments.get("collection", "default"), arguments["url"], md)
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=f"Ingested {n} chunks into '{arguments.get('collection','default')}'")]
        if name == "ingest_file":
            md = rag.file_to_md(arguments["path"])
            n = rag.ingest(arguments.get("collection", "default"), arguments["path"], md)
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=f"Ingested {n} chunks from {arguments['path']}")]
        if name == "rag_query":
            ans, _ = rag.answer(arguments["question"], arguments.get("collection", "default"),
                                arguments.get("model", "qwen3:8b"))
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=ans)]
        if name == "crawl_extract":
            from local_crawl_extract import crawl, ollama_extract, DEFAULT_SCHEMA
            md = await crawl(arguments["url"], verbose=False)
            ext = ollama_extract(md, arguments.get("model", "qwen3:8b"),
                                "Extract title, key_points, summary.", DEFAULT_SCHEMA)
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=json.dumps({"markdown": md, "extracted": ext}, indent=2))]
        if name == "image_query":
            prompt = arguments["prompt"]
            if arguments.get("image_path"):
                with open(arguments["image_path"], "rb") as f:
                    b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()
            elif arguments.get("image_b64"):
                b64 = arguments["image_b64"]
            else:
                return [TextContent(type="text", text="ERROR: provide image_path or image_b64")]
            ans = _moondream(b64, prompt)
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=ans)]
        if name == "web_search":
            import urllib.request as _urllib, json as _json
            from urllib.parse import urlencode
            url = f"{SEARXNG_URL}/search?" + urlencode({"q": arguments["query"], "format": "json"})
            req = _urllib.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "zqm-local/1.0"})
            with _urllib.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
                data = _json.loads(r.read().decode())
            results = data.get("results", [])[:arguments.get("n", 5)]
            out = [{"title": x.get("title"), "url": x.get("url"), "snippet": x.get("content", "")} for x in results]
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=_json.dumps(out, indent=2))]
        if name == "allm_query":
            ws = arguments.get("workspace", "zqm-mesh")
            resp = _allm_request("POST", f"/workspace/{ws}/chat",
                                 {"message": arguments["question"], "mode": arguments.get("mode", "query")})
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=resp.get("textResponse") or json.dumps(resp))]
        if name == "allm_ingest":
            # upload the file to AnythingLLM, then embed it into the workspace
            ws = arguments.get("workspace", "zqm-mesh")
            path = arguments["path"]
            fname = os.path.basename(path)
            boundary = "----zqmboundary1234567890"
            with open(path, "rb") as f:
                fdata = f.read()
            body = (f"--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; "
                    f"filename=\"{fname}\"\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n").encode()
            body += fdata + f"\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n".encode()
            req = urllib.request.Request(f"{ANYTHINGLLM_URL}/api/v1/document/upload",
                                         data=body, method="POST",
                                         headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {ANYTHINGLLM_KEY}",
                                                  "Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
                up = json.loads(r.read())
            loc = None
            docs = up.get("documents", [])
            if docs:
                loc = docs[0].get("location")
            if loc:
                _allm_request("POST", f"/workspace/{ws}/update-embeddings", {"adds": [loc]})
            return [TextContent(type="text", text=f"Uploaded+embedded '{fname}' into workspace '{ws}' (location={loc})")]
    except Exception as e:
        return [TextContent(type="text", text=f"ERROR: {e}")]
    return [TextContent(type="text", text="unknown tool")]


async def main():
    async with stdio_server() as (read, write):
        await app.run(read, write, app.create_initialization_options())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json
    asyncio.run(main())
